samples.content: Source: design/enemies.json enemy imperial_remnant; family 8 제국 근위대 (imperial guard), lumiel_under zone; boss/front-row defense. Exact appearance: 근위대 수십 명이 갑옷째 뒤엉켜, 거대한 방패 수레처럼 기어 나온다 — dozens of imperial guards entangled together in their armor, crawling out like a giant shield wagon. Actions: shield wall, forest of spears, call guard; phase2 last charge, crush with shield wagon. Draw ONE enormous broad crawling mass made from many overlapping armored guard remnants, tower shields and a forest of long spears, interlocked and tangled into a single shield-wagon-like body. Repeated battered steel helmets and plate armor buried among overlapping shields make the many fused guards readable. Dark iron/charcoal steel with restrained aged brass edging and worn leather, no modern details. The mass crawls on intermingled armored limbs at its base; this is a mass of guards resembling a wagon, not a manufactured wheeled vehicle. No actual wheels, no horse, no throne, no crown, banners, cannons or unrelated weapon. No visible living human, blood or gore. Much heavier and larger than mob or chief, large full silhouette without cropping. Keep every spear tip in frame.
